channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Health Ministry official: 'BBC dropped interview after I questioned its reporting'
item.description: Prof. Mitch Schwaber says he asked a senior BBC correspondent how the network would ensure accuracy in a report on Gaza's health situation after citing six examples of what he described as errors and journalistic negligence.

item.title: Iran: Strait of Hormuz won't reopen until US pays price
item.description: Tehran says Washington must end its military pressure and compensate Iran before the crucial shipping lane can be considered open again.

item.title: Opposing Defense Min.: Maj.Gen. Avi Bluth expels Tal Yinon Dardik from Samaria
item.description: Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth decided, contrary to the Defense Minister’s request, to renew the administrative detention order against Tal Yinon Dardik, who is suspected of assaulting a Palestinian.

item.title: Israel demands answers on Ron Arad, missing Jews in Lebanon talks
item.description: Lebanese media say Israel used latest round of negotiations to press for answers on Ron Arad and other Jews missing since Lebanon's civil war.

item.title: Israel Railways expands ETCS pilot to the north
item.description:
Israel Railways has begun conducting passenger-free test runs on the Karmiel-Ahihud line using the ETCS control and signaling system, following the launch of the pilot in the Jerusalem area, Modi'in, and along the Ayalon corridor.
According to Israel Railways, the system is designed to enable an increase in train frequency using the existing rail infrastructure, while improving safety and the management of train traffic.

item.title: Study warns: Israel's eastern border could become 'next October 7'
item.description: A new study paints a troubling picture of the Jordanian border, urging Israel to strengthen ties with Jordan, accelerate construction of border and reinforce Jordan Valley communities.

item.title: Former Beit Shemesh mayor joins Erdan-Edelstein party
item.description: Aliza Bloch officially joins new political party founded by former ministers Gilad Erdan and Yuli Edelstein, after reportedly turning down reserved spot on Likud list.

item.title: Exclusive: Jurisdiction of Givat Harel officially approved
item.description: The jurisdiction of Givat Harel (Carmei Oz) over declared state lands has been officially approved, with Kida and Esh Kodesh receiving official recognition. Israel Ganz: 'A major step toward growth in Binyamin.'

item.title: No relief yet: Heat wave to continue through the week
item.description: Scorching conditions continue across Israel, with Jordan Valley expected to reach 44°C as forecasters warn of heavy to extreme heat stress.

item.title: What Status Quo? The real implications of the 'Mecca Joint Defense Agreement'
item.description: Deterrence replaces normalization: Riyadh has found a way to build real security architecture - with a NATO military power and with the only nuclear state in the Muslim world - without having to declare that it is actually abandoning Washington's normalization track.

item.title: Israeli sovereignty NOW
item.description: Does Arab Palestinianism mean anything more than “Death to Israel!"? It does not seem so, meaning that Israeli sovereignty is the only practical solution.

item.title: 'Put Israel to sleep': Secret recommendation concerning political echelon
item.description: Officials in a Middle Eastern country advised officials in another country to show flexibility, sign an agreement with Israel - and violate it if a large-scale military conflict breaks out. Is Israel once again falling victim to a “conception"?

item.title: Podcast: The smart way to invest a lump sum you don’t need yet
item.description: Before you chase dividends, crypto, or hot stocks, make sure your money has a clear purpose.

item.title: Blow to Gantz: Dedi Simhi weighs move to Likud
item.description: Dedi Simhi, tapped as the No. 2 candidate on Benny Gantz's slate, is reconsidering his political future and considering a jump to Likud if offered a guaranteed spot on their roster.

item.title: Don't wait for Babylon
item.description: Why Christians should examine our own backsliding before condemning Israel or the Jewish People.

item.title: 'Two different Americas' | El-Sayed hits back at Trump post after winning Michigan primary
item.description: Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed pushes back against Trump’s social media post comparing their marriages and visions for the country.

item.title: Lebanese report rules out September negotiations with Israel
item.description: Hezbollah-affiliated Lebanese network report indicates no Israel-Lebanon talks are scheduled for next month, following disagreements over pilot zones and border security.

item.title: Yemen: 7 killed, dozens wounded in Houthi attack on port city of Mocha
item.description:
The Yemeni military and local authorities announced that at least seven people were killed and 30 to 35 others were wounded in a large-scale missile and drone attack launched by Houthi rebels targeting the port city of Mocha.
Earlier, the Houthis claimed responsibility for the incident, alleging the operation targeted weapons depots and Saudi military troop concentrations.

item.title: Hardliner Mohsen Rezaei to head Iran’s Supreme National Security Council
item.description: Iran appoints former Revolutionary Guards commander Mohsen Rezaei as secretary of the Supreme National Security Council following Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr's resignation.

item.title: Justices rule: Sharren Haskel's petition against Likud party dismissed
item.description: Supreme Court unanimously dismisses a petition filed by Sharren Haskel requesting permission to split from the Likud party.

item.title: Iran’s President meets Khamenei amid health rumors
item.description: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian reportedly meets Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to discuss the military and domestic situation amid rumors regarding Khamenei's health.

item.title: Bennett: Gafni, Bibi, and Deri are one and the same
item.description:
The chairman of the "Together" party, Naftali Bennett, responded to remarks made by MK Moshe Gafni, who announced that he would no longer commit in advance to automatically backing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
"Make no mistake - Gafni, Bibi, and Deri are one and the same," Bennett said. He added that "anyone who truly wants to draft haredim and support IDF soldiers knows that they must keep the architects of draft evasion, Deri and Gafni, out of the government."

item.title: Poll: Tropper, Hendel, Erdan, and Edelstein fail to clear threshold
item.description: A new Kan 11 News poll reveals that all newly formed political parties are falling well short of the electoral threshold. Meanwhile, the Likud party sees a modest uptick in support.

item.title: Worker seriously injured in fall in Hevel Modi'in
item.description:
A worker in his 40s was seriously injured after falling from a height of approximately eight meters at the Hevel Modi'in Industrial Park.
Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Sheba Hospital in Tel Hashomer.

item.title: Trump names Jewish lawyer Will Scharf as next White House counsel
item.description: President Trump announces that White House staff secretary Will Scharf will take over as White House counsel on September 1, replacing David Warrington.

item.title: Gafni refuses to pledge advance support for Netanyahu
item.description: The chairman of the Degel HaTorah party, MK Moshe Gafni, said at an event on Sunday evening, "Unlike in the past, I am not declaring in advance that we will go with Netanyahu."

item.title: Secret revealed: Top Hamas commander held in Israel for two years
item.description: Terrorist Basel Salahieh, a senior commander in Hamas's military wing, has been secretly detained in Israel for two years and is now set to face trial.

item.title: Motorcyclist seriously injured after being struck by car in Jaljulia
item.description:
A motorcyclist in his 20s was seriously injured after being hit by a car in Jaljulia.
Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene and evacuated him to Beilinson Hospital in Petah Tikva.

item.title: Houthi forces launch missiles and drones at Yemen’s port city of Mocha
item.description: Houthi forces renew missile and drone strikes on the Red Sea port city of Mocha, targeting Saudi-backed military assets amid mounting tensions.

item.description: "I think that there is in some respects confusion in the black community. There are some people who hear things that Mamdani says and it reminds them of some things that happened to them at some point." Interview.
